Department Profile
As Nonoi College was established in 1985, 'English' as a 'core' subject was introduce from that particular year; i.e 1985-86. The department of English offered B.A. Regular course following UGC rules under Gauhati University. In 2012, 'English Major' Course was introduced when semester system was applied by Gauhati University. Now, The Department of English is offering B.A. Regular course and also Honours course following UG-CBCS (under Gauhati choice based credit system). The student are admitted on the basis of marks in the HS(10+2) standard examinations conducted by Assam Higher secondary Education Council (AHSEC) or Central Board of Secondary Education(CBCS) or any other equivalent examinations. In Honours Course, Students have to obtain minimum 60% marks in 'English' is the previous examination presently The Department of English is giving teaching to the students of 'English' Compulsory Core(ENG-CC)', "English communication (AECC)", "Alternative English", 'English Honours Course (ENG-HC)', General English(Old Course).
